chunks: We shall leave them on that day surging like waves pressing one against the other, and the trumpet blast will be sounded, when We shall gather them all together.
ai.seo_question: What happens to people on the Day of Judgment before the Trumpet is blown?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, the phrase 'surging against one another' (yamujju fi ba'd) is interpreted as a vivid depiction of the intense confusion and mutual hostility among the disbelievers as they are gathered for reckoning. This chaos precedes the final gathering, emphasizing Allah's absolute power to assemble all humanity from every corner of the earth for divine judgment.
